sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: Good News Club wants to hold meetings in a public school. Milford Central School denies the request. The group claims this violates free speech rights. The school claims it must avoid religious endorsement.

sections.heading: Why it matters
paragraphs: This case defines public school access rules. It balances free speech against religious neutrality. Schools must decide how to manage shared spaces. Religious groups seek equal access to public facilities. The outcome shapes future school policies nationwide.
